description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer (B2B Contract)
B2B contract until 31 December 2026 | Full time | Remote, Romania | Start date: Monday 5th October

hedgehog lab is a digital product consultancy and certified B Corp with 20 years of experience. We need a senior QA engineer to support our growing number of client projects.

What you'll do

  • Own testing across several client projects at once

  • Build and improve automated test frameworks, using Playwright where possible

  • Test APIs, integrations and data

  • Work with developers and clients to plan testing and flag risks early

What we're looking for

  • At least 4 years in manual and automated testing

  • Strong skills in TypeScript, Java, C# or Python

  • Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks

  • Confidence with API testing and data validation

  • Experience with test case management tools such as TestRail, and CI/CD

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Playwright with TypeScript

  • AWS or Azure

  • Using GenAI tools in your QA work

Start date

This role starts on Monday 5th October, so we can only consider people who can start on that date.
